newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Nasan Ind sets rights, bonus issues.
newsitem.headline: Nasan Ind sets rights, bonus issues.

text.p: South Korea's Nasan Industrial Co Ltd said on Thursday it plans to offer a 19-for-100 rights issue in December and a 1-for-10 bonus issue in January.
The company's paid-in capital would rise to 30 billion won from 22.3 billion won at present, a company statement said.
Nasan plans a rights issue of 1.0 million shares, 20 percent of which would be offered to employees.
The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of November 28 for rights, the statement said.
The rights issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for December 19 and 20, with payment due by January 6.
